description: Forced six-step at duty 0.107, chosen so the current vector matches the FOC legs at about 0.53 A. Angle is forced, so this isolates the commutation scheme from the angle source.
notes: Matched-current leg of the three-scheme sweep on the small bench motor (flux 0.937 mWb, 7 pole pairs).

Ripple UNDER-RESOLVED at 4.2 samples per ripple period — the figure is a lower bound. Both schemes are sampled identically at this speed, so the ratio between them remains valid even though the absolute values do not.

CORRECTION (2026-08-03, session 26): this is a FORCED run, and sector rate measures the commutation clock, not the rotor. A later coast-tail check on a comparable run showed the rotor slipping at 64%% of command. Rotor speed here is UNVERIFIED; the ripple figures remain valid as electrical measurements at the commanded switching pattern. See docs/SIXSTEP-REVIEW.md.
title: Six-step (trapezoidal), 597 rad/s el
